<proposed_plan>
# Invalid Git Write Commands

## Summary
- 结论：只读 sub-agent 不得执行会修改 index、工作树或 refs 的 Git 命令。

## Flow Decision
- `flow_type`: `normal`
- `flow_source`: `user_explicit`
- `lock_status`: `locked`
- 开发基线：`origin/main`

## Goals
- 目标 1: 覆盖 Git 写入命令
  checker 必须拒绝 add、stage、checkout、restore 和 apply。

## Non-goals
- 不开放 sub-agent 的任何 Git 写入能力。

## Task Orchestration
- wave: 1
  - sub-agent:add [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git add files in the repository (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:stage [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git stage changes in the worktree (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:checkout [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git checkout the current worktree file (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:restore [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git restore files in the repository (skill: $normal-flow)
  - sub-agent:apply [gpt-5.6-luna, xhigh] => git apply the patch (skill: $normal-flow)

## Acceptance & Validation
- checker 必须拒绝所有 Git 写入命令。

## Assumptions/Defaults
- 用于负例：已确定
</proposed_plan>
